entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The demon parun and guildmaster of the Cult of Rakdos on Ravnica, an ancient hedonistic demon who slumbers in a lava pit in Rix Maadi.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of performers and revelers led by Rakdos.

entities.name: Izolda
entities.description: Acting guildmaster of the cult who raised Rakdos during Dissension and was torn apart by her followers.

entities.name: Myc Zunich
entities.description: Son of Jarad whose blood awakened Rakdos and who briefly controlled him.

entities.name: Jarad
entities.description: Golgari guildmaster, father of Myc Zunich.

entities.name: Momir Vig
entities.description: Supplied Izolda with cerebral fluid and planned to use Project Kraj; killed by Agrus Kos.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: Killed Momir Vig; later entered Rix Maadi and found Rakdos asleep, proving his innocence.

entities.name: Project Kraj
entities.description: Momir Vig's weapon to defeat Rakdos, which fell during the fight.

entities.name: Feather
entities.description: The new Boros guildmaster who dumped Rakdos' body back in his lava pit.

entities.name: Hekara
entities.description: Rakdos' emissary, killed and revived as a bloodwitch by Tomik.

entities.name: Tomik
entities.description: Brought Hekara's corpse back so she was revived.

entities.name: Exava
entities.description: Tried to object to Hekara's leaving and lost to her in a fight.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: Led a group to convince guilds to help in Niv-Mizzet's plan.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Izzet dragon whose plan was to become the new Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Rode Rakdos in the attack on Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Dragon who knocked Rakdos out of the air.

entities.name: Judith
entities.description: Plotted to replace Rakdos, framed him for murders and imprisoned Kos; later attacked by Massacre Girl.

entities.name: Massacre Girl
entities.description: Attacked Judith for weakening the guild.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: Murdered, alongside Teysa Karlov.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: Murdered, prompting Judith to frame Rakdos.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: Recruited Rakdos for his heist of Maag Taranau.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Knocked into the distance by Rakdos when trying to stop Oko's theft.

entities.name: Akul
entities.description: Defeated by Rakdos in a brawl outside Maag Taranau.

entities.name: Tinybones
entities.description: A Dominarian skeleton thief befriended by Rakdos.

entities.name: Rix Maadi
entities.description: Location of Rakdos' lava pit lair.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: Plane to which Oko lured Rakdos.

entities.name: Maag Taranau
entities.description: Site of Oko's heist.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Conflict in which Rakdos helped fight Bolas.

entities.name: Dissension
entities.description: The time of Izolda's raising of Rakdos.

events.summary: Izolda raises Rakdos from his pit with Myc Zunich's blood; Myc briefly controls him before Izolda takes control.
events.quote: Izolda was able to finish the ritual and took control over Rakdos herself.

events.summary: Agrus Kos kills Momir Vig, Kraj falls, Rakdos is badly damaged and Izolda is torn apart by her cultists; Rakdos falls into a coma.
events.quote: However, Vig was killed by Agrus Kos and Kraj fell later, during the fight.

events.summary: Feather dumps Rakdos' body back into his lava pit.
events.quote: Later, the new Boros guildmaster Feather dumped Rakdos' body back into his lava pit

events.summary: Hekara is revived as a bloodwitch and goes to help Kaya's group; Rakdos does not stop her.
events.quote: Hekara's corpse was brought back by Tomik and she was revived as a bloodwitch.

events.summary: Rakdos attacks Nicol Bolas with Gideon Jura riding him and is knocked from the air.
events.quote: He was knocked out of the air by Bolas when Gideon was riding him.

events.summary: Judith frames Rakdos for the Karlov Manor murders, imprisoning Agrus Kos who found Rakdos asleep.
events.quote: Judith imprisoned Kos, leaving nobody who could advocate for the demon's innocence.

events.summary: Rakdos' name is cleared and Judith is attacked by Massacre Girl.
events.quote: Judith was later attacked by Massacre Girl for trying to weaken the guild, leaving her whereabouts unknown.

events.summary: Oko recruits Rakdos for his heist of Maag Taranau on Thunder Junction; Rakdos knocks away Ral Zarek and defeats Akul.
events.quote: Oko recruited Rakdos for his heist of Maag Taranau

relations.quote: is the demon parun and guildmaster of the Cult of Rakdos on Ravnica .

relations.note: Raised him but sought to control him.
relations.quote: Izolda , the then-acting guildmaster of the cult, raised Rakdos from his pit
However, Vig was killed by Agrus Kos
because Hekara , his emissary was killed
Judith was plotting against him and planning to take his place as the guildmaster.
He also befriended the Dominarian skeleton thief Tinybones
